codex.reason: Reviewers start as native subagents without the reviewer agent's guard, since a Codex hook lets a tool call through when it fails, so their prompts are their only boundary, at the configured reviewer effort but on the session's model; its gh calls need network access, which Codex's default sandbox turns off.

copilot-cli.reason: The generic reviewer and delegation-free specialists run inline, without the reviewer agent's guard, since a Copilot CLI hook lets a tool call through when it times out; a specialists manifest that keeps agent-delegation fails.
